description: Requires signing in to Plain; calling it prompts sign-in when needed. Lists the active insurance policies for the currently selected Plain company on this connection, including product, carrier, dates, price and billing details. Amounts are in major currency units (e.g. DKK). totalPrice is the total price the customer pays; it is legally required to be split into the insurance premium and fees (statutory fees and taxes). Whenever you mention a price, state the total and its split into premium and fees.
name: list_active_policies

anyOf.description: How often the customer pays: Monthly or Annual. Prices are per period of this frequency.

fees.description: Statutory fees and taxes part of totalPrice, in major currency units. Not part of the premium.

premium.description: Insurance premium part of totalPrice, in major currency units. Excludes fees.

product.description: Public product slug for matching the onboarding catalog, when available.

totalPrice.description: Total price per billing period in major currency units (e.g. DKK, not øre). This is the full amount the customer pays and equals premium + fees. Never present it as the premium alone.

title: List active policies
